description: Fragment 3/18 jednego ciągłego ujęcia. First f0097 → Last f0145. 3 s, 24 fps, normalne tempo 1×; bez przyspieszania. Pozycja w sekwencji: 6–9 s. prompts.image: Generate a NEW photorealistic BACKGROUND PLATE, not an edit. There is NO FEATHER, no bird, no floating foreground object anywhere. Image1 is the feather-free Blender spatial blueprint: retain its camera projection, crop, object placement and sizes exactly. Supporting reference images supply only specified identities/designs/materials. Keep framing even if it seems empty; foreground subject will be composited later. Do not fill the empty foreground or recompose. Generate a NEW photorealistic 16:9 version of exact Blender view in images1 and3 (same geometry reference repeated). Image2 provides actual Poznań railway materials, no viewpoint. Copy every main edge's projected position. MOST IMPORTANT: bridge parapet must run from LEFT EDGE at65% canvasheight to RIGHTEDGE at20%, rising diagonally to right. Lower edge fromleft75%toright30%. Do not make it shallower or move it higher. Keep the exact matching diagonal in the supplied render. Tracks and platform rooftops behind it retain their original size and converging lines. Lamp atupperright sameplace, tiny cropped silver car rightside sameprojectedsize. No horizon. It floats foreground, not attached to parapet. Duskbluefill, modestwarmlights. No people/newobjects. Strict pixel layout from Blender more important than attractive photography. Entire output contains no feather or white floating speck. Realistic anatomy and mechanically rigid vehicles, dry charcoal coat for the man, consistent blue dusk and warm station lights. Landscape16:9.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Wspólna klatka graniczna f0145; dokładne zakończenie segmentu i początek następnego.
prompts.animation: 0-3s: Descend from above the road and turn toward the passing mixer entering from screen right. Track alongside its driver-side window, lowering to the exterior window-level profile of the supplied End Frame. Stay outside the cab. Traffic moves continuously nose-first along the lanes relative to the fixed road; visible wheels roll, lane spacing stays constant. No vehicle stops for the camera. The driver looks screen left, hands maintaining their grips with tiny steering corrections. Exterior scenery flows screen right. Preserve truck fittings, lettering, lights and vehicle proportions. Camera motion continues through both boundaries, reaching the supplied End Frame at 3s. Keep architecture rigid and dusk exposure stable. No feather, cuts, dissolves, morphs or new people. @Image1: the same mixer design only; retain the Start/End crop and visible fittings. @Image2: the existing driver's face and hair only; keep his robe from Start/End.
